Class DOTCFMPSParser<N,L,E,AP,TP extends MutableProceduralModalEdgeProperty,P extends MutableProceduralModalProcessGraph<N,L,E,AP,TP>>

All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelDeserializer<ContextFreeModalProcessSystem<L,AP>>
public class DOTCFMPSParser<N,L,E,AP,TP extends MutableProceduralModalEdgeProperty,P extends MutableProceduralModalProcessGraph<N,L,E,AP,TP>> extends Object implements ModelDeserializer<ContextFreeModalProcessSystem<L,AP>>
Parses a DOT file that defines a ContextFreeModalProcessSystem.

Besides the typical structure of DOT files, this parser expects/supports the following attributes in order to correctly parse the semantics of ContextFreeModalProcessSystems:

  • Nodes must provide a "process" attribute that denotes the process a node belongs to
  • Nodes may provide a "main" attribute that denotes whether their respective process is the main process. Exactly one process must mark their nodes as main process nodes.
  • Nodes may provide a "final" attribute to denote their final state. Exactly one node per (sub-) process must be marked as a final node.
  • Edges may provide "modality" and "procedurality" attributes to denote their ModalEdgeProperty.ModalType and ProceduralModalEdgeProperty.ProceduralType. If missing, the respective parser may provide default values instead.
